algorithm: Reject ill-formed input that is not a sequence of Unicode scalar values.
Reject any scalar whose Unicode 15.1.0 General_Category is Unassigned (Cn).
Apply NFC according to UAX #15 revision 54 and Unicode 15.1.0.
Recheck that the result contains no Unicode 15.1.0 Unassigned scalar.
Encode the result as shortest-form UTF-8 without BOM.

identifier_security.policy: Causal machine identifiers are ASCII-only under registries.json; Unicode security profiles do not apply to them.
